name: Anti-Mage
rules:
Hexproof
An opponent losing unspent mana causes that player to lose that much life.
At the beginning of each opponent’s end step, that player activates a mana ability of up to one land they control if able.
flavor: “Magic shall not prevail!”

name: Abaddon, the Lord of Avernus
rules:
Deathtouch
Whenever a Spirit you control enters, put a shield counter on it. (If it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead (If it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.)
flavor: “You have called death upon yourself.”

name: Razzil Darkbrew, the Alchemist
rules:
When Razzil enters, create a Treasure token.
When Razzil becomes monstrous, it gains double strike until end of turn.
flavor: “Easy now, this stuff is explosive!”

name: Kaldr, the Ancient Apparition
rules:
Flying
At the beginning of each opponent’s end step, you may put a stun counter on up to one target tapped creature they control.
flavor: “One day, ice will cover these lands, and it will be as if this war never happened.”

name: Zet, the Arc Warden
rules:
When Zet enters, create a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token named Tempest Double.
At the beginning of your end step, modify target Illusion you control. (To modify a creature, attach an Aura you control to it, attach an Equipment you control to it, or move any number of counters from another permanent you control onto it.)
flavor: “Matter has been split from its intended form. These must be made to unite.”

name: Roshan, the Immortal
rules:
When Roshan, the Immortal enters, any number of target creatures you control each deal damage equal to their power to target creature you don’t control.
Enchant creature
When enchanted creature dies or is put into exile, return that card to the battlefield under its owner’s control.
flavor: Roshan’s punishment for killing a shopkeeper is to be slain and reborn for an eternity by the Radiant and Dire alike.

name: Mogul Khan, the Axe
rules:
As long as Mogul Khan is untapped during an opponent’s declare attackers step, that opponent must attack you with at least one creature if able.
Enrage — Whenever Mogul Khan is dealt damage, each player sacrifices a permanent.
flavor: “You fought badly—died worse.”

name: Atropos, the Bane
rules:
Flying
When Atropos enters, tap each creature target opponent controls.They don’t untap during their controller’s next untap step.
Whenever a creature an opponent controls becomes tapped, that player mills one card.
flavor: “The rebirth of my dream means the end of a myriad others.”

name: Radiant Creep
rules: Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Radiant Mega Creep
rules:
Trample
When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature you control.

name: Radiant Super Creep
rules:
Vigilance
Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Black Hole
rules:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary permanent.)
Exile all nonland permanents your opponents control.
flavor: “Stare into the abyss.” — Enigma, the Consumer of Worlds

name: Dire Creep
rules: Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Dire Super Creep
rules:
Menace
Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Boots of Speed
rules:
Equipped creature has haste.
Equip 0
flavor: Fleet footwear, increasing movement.

name: Finger of Death
rules:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature.)
Finger of Death deals twice X damage to any target. If that target was a player, that player discards X cards.
flavor: “When you get to Hell, tell them I sent you.” — Lion, the Demon Witch

name: Stifling Dagger
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets -1/-1.
At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature’s controller, that player loses 1 life.
flavor: “Where falls my shadow, fells my blade.”  — Mortred, the Phantom Assassin

name: Roshan’s Pit
rules:
T: Add C
T: Add one mana of any color to your mana pool. Spend this mana only on legendary creatures.
4, T, Sacrifice this land: Target legendary creature you control fights target creature you don’t control. Activate only as a sorcery.
flavor: The depths of Roshan’s lair quake to signal his emergence.

name: Kobold Thief
rules: When this creature dies, create a Treasure token.

name: Fortification
rules:
Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
Draw a card.
flavor: A powerful glyph, it makes allies impervious to all damage for some time.

name: Observer Ward
rules:
Vanishing 4 (This permanent enters with 4 time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)
T: Add C.
flavor: A form of half-sentient plant, often cultivated by apprentice wizards.

name: Blink Dagger
rules:
Flash
When Blink Dagger enters, exile target creature you control. Return that card to the battlefield under your control, then attach this equipment to it.
Equipped creature can’t be blocked.
Equip 2
flavor: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.

name: Sentry Ward
rules:
Vanishing 4 (This permanent enters with 4 time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)
Creatures your opponents control lose hexproof and shroud and can’t have hexproof and shroud. Ward abilities of those creatures don’t trigger.
T: Add C.
flavor: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.

name: Karroch, the Beastmaster
rules:
When Karroch enters, create a 2/2 green Boar creature token with wither and a 1/1 white Hawk creature token with flying.
Creature tokens you control have first strike.
flavor: “Welcome to the food chain.”

name: Strygwyr, the Bloodseeker
rules:
Bloodthirst 1 (If an opponent was dealt damage this turn, this creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.)
As long as an opponent has less than half their starting life total, Strygwyr has double strike.
flavor: “For the Flayed Twins, I seek blood.”

name: Gondar, the Bounty Hunter
rules:
Menace (This creature can’t be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a bounty counter on target creature you don’t control.
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, create a treasure token for each counter that was on that creature.
flavor: “It was just business before. Now it’s personal.”

name: Mangix, the Brewmaster
rules:
Trample
Whenever you cast your third spell in a turn, transform this creature.
Trample, hexproof, menace
When Mangix transforms, draw a card.
At the beginning of your end step, transform Mangix.
flavor:
“Drink and be bleary, for tomorrow we die!”
secondary_copyright_2: Valve

name: Rigwarl, the Bristleback
rules:
T: Rigwarl deals 1 damage to target creature you control.
Enrage — Whenever Rigwarl is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it. It deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
flavor: “More where that came from, sunshine.”

name: Black Arachnia, the Broodmother
rules:
Deathtouch
If a creature an opponent controls would die, instead exile it and create a 1/1 black Spider creature token with deathtouch.
4BB: Spiders you control get +X/+X and gain lifelink until end of turn, where X is the number of Spiders you control.
flavor: “You’re not afraid of spiders, are you?”

name: Bradwarden, the Centaur Warrunner
rules:
Creatures you control have haste and trample.
If damage would be dealt to Bradwarden, prevent that damage. Bradwarden deals that much damage to any target instead.
flavor: “These proving grounds shall be littered with the dead.”

name: Chaos Knight
rules:
Menace
When Chaos Knight enters, roll a d6. Create X 6/6 black and red Illusion Knight creature tokens named Phantasm Illusion, where X is the result.
flavor: “Fall to your knees and lament.”

name: Chen, the Holy Knight
rules: When Chen enters, return target nonlegendary creature from your graveyard to your hand.
flavor: “I have left the dark desert of my past to walk now in the light of Obelis.”

name: Magebane Mirror
rules:
Counter target spell or ability that targets a creature you control. If a spell or ability is countered this way, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
Draw a card.
flavor: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.

name: Clinkz, the Bone Fletcher
rules:
First strike, skulk, haste
When Clinkz enters or attacks, amass Skeletons 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control. It’s also a Skeleton. If you don’t control an Army, create a 0/0 black Skeleton Army creature token first.)
flavor: “Fire grows hungrier the more it’s fed.”

name: Rylai, the Crystal Maiden
rules:
When Rylai enters, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls. You may put a stun counter on it.  (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost 1 less to cast.
flavor: “Guess you didn’t know a little game of freeze tag could turn lethal.”

name: Ish'Kafel, the Dark Seer
rules:
Vigilance
When Ish’Kafel enters, create a token copy of target legendary creature an opponent controls.
flavor: “Your life, much like your head, lacked a point.”

name: Mireska, the Dark Willow
rules:
Flying
Whenever a player draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, they lose 1 life.
flavor: “A little mischief never killed anyone... well, you I guess.”

name: Valora, the Dawnbreaker
rules:
Flash
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 or one mana of that creature’s color.)
When Valora enters, prevent all damage that would be dealt to creatures you control this turn.
flavor: “My powers, like my life, were given to me. The will to wield them justly I found on my own.”

name: Aghanim’s Sceptre
rules:
T: Add WUBRG. Spend this mana only to cast legendary spells.
Whenever you cast a legendary spell, you may draw a card.
flavor: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

name: Dazzle, the Shadow Priest
rules:
T: Another target creature you control gains undying until end of turn. (When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner’s control with a +1/+1 counter on it.)
B/G, T: Remove a counter from target creature.
flavor: “Where my shadow falls, there falls my foe.”

name: Deafening Blast
rules: Return target creature to its owner’s hand. Its controller mills two cards. (To mill two cards, a player puts the top two cards of their library into their graveyard.)
flavor: “I am a beacon of knowledge blazing out across a black sea of ignorance.” — Carl, the Invoker

name: Grimstroke
rules:
Flying
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a token copy of target creature an opponent controls. It has haste and double strike. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
flavor: “The battlefield is merely a canvas, waiting for my brush.”

name: Krobelus, the Death Prophet
rules:
Flying
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Whenever a creature token you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: “What I’ve seen goes far beyond death.”

name: Disruptor, the Stormcrafter
rules:
When Disruptor enters, put target creature an opponent controls on top of its owner’s library.
T, 4UR: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
flavor: “Feeling under the weather?”

name: Lucifer, the Doom
rules:
Devour 1 (As this enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures. This creature enters with that many +1/+1 counters on it.)
If a nonlegendary creature would die, exile it with a void counter on it instead.
Lucifer has all abilities of creatures exiled with void counters on them.
flavor: “I am the midnight of your soul.”

name: Piercing Shot
rules: Destroy target creature. Surveil 1.  (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)

name: Kaolin, the Earth Spirit
rules:
When Kaolin enters, an artifact token called Stone Remnant for each Spirit you control. (They have no abilities).
Sacrifice an artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on target Spirit you control. That creature gains trample until end of turn.
Sacrifice an artifact: Kaolin deals 2 damage to each creature with flying.
flavor: “Through conflict, one’s nature is revealed.”

name: Echo Slam
rules:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 or one mana of that creature’s color.)
Echo Slam deals X damage to each creature, where is X the number of creatures on the battlefield.
flavor: “No one sees an earthquake coming.” — Raigor, the Earthshaker

name: Raigor Stonehoof, the Earthshaker
rules:
Trample
Whenever Raigor attacks, double its power until end of turn.
If a creature you control would deal excess combat damage to a player, it deals twice that much damage instead.
flavor: “There may be many earths, but there’s only one Earthshaker.”

name: Elder Titan, the Worldsmith
rules:
Ward—Sacrifice a land.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Each land card in your hand has “Basic landcycling 1”.
flavor: “What long ago I shattered must be rendered whole.

name: Xin, the Ember Spirit
rules:
First strike
When Xin enters, it deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Spirits you control.
flavor: “You... have learned nothing.”

name: Aiushtha, the Enchantress
rules:
Vigilance
When Aiushtha enters, gain control of target non-legendary creature for as long as you control Aiushtha.
flavor: “It’s a hop, skip and a jump!”

name: Enigma, Consumer of Worlds
rules:
Flying
At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice another nontoken creature you control. When you do, create three 1/1 black Eidolon creature tokens.
flavor: “That which is fundamental cannot be destroyed.”

name: Darkterror, the Faceless Void
rules:
U/B: Exile Darkterror with a time counter on it. If it doesn’t have suspend, it gains suspend.
Whenever Darkterror enters, draw a card. Then, exile a nonland card from your hand with X time counters on it, where X is that card’s mana value. If that card doesn’t have suspend, it gains suspend.
flavor: “Time is a river with many eddies. I have seen its head waters, and I have seen its currents reach the sea.”

name: Chronosphere
rules:
(You may cast a legendary instant only if you control a legendary creature or planeswalker.)
Split Second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can’t cast spells or activate abilities that aren’t mana abilities.)
End the turn.
flavor: “I have seen the future; you’re not in it.” — Darkterror, the Faceless Void

name: Hoodwink
rules:
Vigilance, reach
Whenever Hoodwink deals combat damage to an opponent, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
flavor: “You ever hear the one about the tortoise and the hare and the squirrel that shot ‘em both?”

name: Ice Vortex
rules: Tap up to two target creatures you don’t control. You may put a stun counter on either of them. Then, draw a card for each tapped creature your opponents control.
flavor: Kaldr’s presence draws those around him into a frozen void, threatening to lock them in an icy prison for eternity.

name: Huskar, the Sacred Warrior
rules:
Haste
T: Huskar deals damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down.
flavor: “Great honors await you in the Nothl Realm.”

name: Carl, the Invoker
rules:
Prowess
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, if it had blue in its cost, draw a card. If it had red in its cost, Carl deals 2 damage to any target. If it had black in its cost, each opponent discards a card.
flavor: “Did I hear a squeak?”

name: Dragon Tail
rules:
Tap target creature and put a stun counter on it.
Draw a card.
flavor: Davion’s combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

name: Whirling Death
rules:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice any number of lands.
Add X mana in any combination of R and/or G. Whirling Death deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.
flavor: “I’m not a lumberjack. This. This is personal. — Rizzrack, the Timbersaw

name: Kraken Shell
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has hexproof. (This creature can’t be the target of spells of abilities your opponents control.)
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to enchanted creature.
flavor: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.

name: Io, the Wisp
rules:
Flying
Soulbond (You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.)
As long as Io is paired with another creature, each of those creatures have “2W: Exile this creature, then return it to the battlefield under your control.”
flavor: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.

name: Overcharge
rules:
Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains double strike until end of turn.
Draw a card.
flavor: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.

name: Arena of Blood
rules:
At the beginning of each player’s upkeep, this enchantment deals 2 damage to that player.
Each creature attacks each combat if able.
flavor: “DADADA DA DA DA-DA-DA!” — Mars, the First Son of Heaven

name: Shackleshot
rules:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
Enchant land
When this Aura enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this Aura leaves the battlefield. (That creature returns under its owner’s control.)
flavor: “I now pronounce you man and tree.” — Lyralei, the Windranger

name: Rot
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +0/-1 and has deathtouch.
When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
flavor: “Fill your lungs up.” — Pudge, the Butcher

name: Open Wounds
rules:
Target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
Creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.
flavor: Sometimes, it’s the first slash cuts the deepest.

name: Naix, the Lifestealer
rules:
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
Emerge 5BBB (You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature’s mana value.)
When Naix enters, destroy target creature.
flavor: “Your life, stolen right out from under you.”

name: Town Portal Scroll
rules:
2, T, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a basic land card. Put it on to the battlefield tapped.
4, T, Sacrifice Town Portal Scroll: Return target creature you control to its owner’s hand.
flavor: What a hero truly needs.

name: Reincarnation
rules:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature.)
Return target legendary creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with finality counter on it.
flavor: “Death has no grip on me.” — Ostarion, the Wraith King

name: Ostarion, the Wraith King
rules:
First strike, lifelink
Whenever Ostarion attacks, create three 1/1 black Skeleton creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
flavor: “Was that some sort of misguided tribute?”

name: Presence of the Dark Lord
rules:
Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1.
Whenever a creature dies, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one’s soul.

name: Soul Ring
rules:
Soul Ring enters tapped.
T: Add BR to your mana pool. Soul Ring deals 3 damage to you.
flavor: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

name: Hand of Midas
rules: T, Sacrifice Hand of Midas: Destroy target nonlegendary creature you control. You create X treasure tokens, where X is that creature’s mana value.
flavor: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner’s pockets.

name: Mekansm
rules:
Creatures you control get +0/+1.
Each creature you control with defender can attack and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than power.
T: You gain 1 life for each creature you control.
flavor: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

name: Drums of Endurance
rules:
This artifact enters with three charge counters on it.
T, Remove a charge counter from Drums of Endurance: The next creature spell you cast this turn has riot. (It enters the battlefield with your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.)
flavor: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

name: Meepo, the Geomancer
rules:
Multikicker U (You may pay an additional U any number of times as you cast this spell.)
When Meepo enters, create a token copy of it for each time it was kicked.
As long as Meepo is a token, it is not legendary.
When Meepo leaves the battlefield, exile all other cards named Meepo, the Geomancer.
flavor: “I guess size ain’t everything, eh?”

name: Jakiro, the Twin Head Dragon
rules:
Flying, haste
Whenever Jakiro attacks, it deals 2 damage divided as you choose among up to two targets.
Whenever Jakiro attacks, tap up to one target permanent.
flavor: “Tis an honor to die by dragons.”

name: Yurnero, the Juggernaut
rules:
Hexproof (This creature can’t be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
Whenever you cast an equipment spell, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
flavor: “There’s a fine line between bravery and stupidity.”

name: Ezalor, the Keeper of the Light
rules:
Prowess
Whenever you cast your second spell during an opponent’s turn, tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn’t untap for as long as you control Ezalor.
flavor: “I’ll forego green girdles and questing beasts, for all such knightly trifles pale before the light.”
render: Ezalor the Keeper of the Light.jpg

name: Kunkka, the Admiral
rules:
Vigilance
Whenever a Spirit you control deals combat damage to a player, create a map token. (It’s an artifact with “1, T, Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.”)
flavor: “This’ll trim your sails!”

name: Fiend’s Grip
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature loses all abilities and can’t attack or block.
At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature’s controller, that player mills cards equal to that creature’s mana value. (To mill a card, a player puts the top card of their library into their graveyard.)
flavor: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.

name: Tresdin, the Legion Commander
rules:
Haste
Whenever Tresdin attacks, you may have it fight up to one target creature an opponent controls.
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dealt damage by Tresdin this turn dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Tresdin.
flavor: “I’ve come to put an end to hope.”

name: Leshrac, the Tormented Soul
rules:
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
As long as you’ve cast two or more spells this turn, Leshrac gets +2/+0 and has vigilance. (Attacking doesn’t cause this creature to tap.)
flavor: “Your desolation and the world’s are one.”

name: Lina, the Slayer
rules:
Flying, prowess, prowess (Each instance of prowess triggers separately)
Whenever Lina attacks, exile target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard. Lina gets +1/+1 for each card exiled with it.
Whenever you cast your third spell in a turn, sacrifice Lina. When you do, return all cards exiled with it to their owners’ hand.
flavor: “Better to burn out, than fade away.”

name: Lion, the Demon Witch
rules:
At the beginning of your end step, if Lion is in your graveyard, you may sacrifice a creature you control. If you do, return Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
When Lion dies, add BR.
flavor: “I’ve been to Hell and back, and back to Hell…and back again.”

name: Luna, the Moon Rider
rules:
When Luna enters, you gain 3 life.
At the beginning combat on your turn, if you gained 6 or more life this turn, transform Luna.
flavor:
“By Nightsilver!”
secondary_copyright_2: Valve

name: Banehallow, the Lycan
rules:
At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control two or more Wolves, transform Banehallow.
When Banehollow enters, create two 2/2 black Wolf creature tokens.
Menace
Wolves you control get +2/+2 and have menace.
flavor:
“I am the alpha wolf.”
secondary_copyright_2: Valve

name: Puck, the Faerie Dragon
rules:
Flying
When Puck enters or phases in, tap target creature.
W/U: Puck phases out. (While it’s phased out, it’s treated as though it doesn’t exist. It phases in before its controller untaps during their next untap step.)
flavor: “Stay and amuse me!”

name: Magnus, the Magnoceros
rules:
Trample
When one or more creatures you control deals excess combat damage to an opponent, draw a card.
flavor: “You must have mistaken my purpose…to flatten you!”

name: Marci
rules:
Soulbond (You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.)
As long as Marci is paired with another creature, both creatures get +1/+1 and have lifelink.
flavor: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

name: Mars, the First Son of Heaven
rules:
Menace, haste
Creatures your opponents control can’t be the target of spells or abilities that player controls.
flavor: “Let the name Mars ring across the battlefield, and bear witness to my enemy’s flight.”
render: Mars the First Son of Heaven.jpg

name: Medusa, the Gorgon
rules:
Vigilance, reach
Whenever a creature deals combat damage to Medusa, put a defender counter on it.
flavor: “Never come between a Gorgon and her sisters”

name: Mirana of Nightsilver
rules:
When Mirana enters the battlefield, draw a card, then discard a card.
When you draw your third card in a turn, transform Mirana.
flavor:
“The stars are in alignment, and our victory is certain.”
secondary_copyright_2: Valve

name: Wukong, the Monkey King
rules:
Vigilance
Whenever you cast your second spell in a turn, create a 3/3 green Ape creature token with vigilance.
flavor: “My next great challenge will be your last.”

name: Morphling, the Waveform
rules: When Morphling attacks, it becomes a copy of target creature you don’t control except its name is Morphling, it is legendary in addition to its other types, and it has Morphling’s abilities.
flavor: “You’re washed up!”

name: Slithice, the Naga Siren
rules:
When Slithice deals combat damage to a player, that player skips their next combat phase.
T: Target creature an opponent controls attacks during its controller’s next turn if able.
flavor:
“From this sleep you will not wake.”
Valve

name: Tormentor
rules:
When Tormentor enters, it deals 4 damage divided randomly among creatures you control.
Legendary spells you control cost 1 less to cast.
Whenever you cast a legendary spell, draw a card then discard a card.
flavor: Innocuous as first, the Divine Sentinel lashes out at anyone who dares draw near.

name: Nature’s Grasp
rules: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. If it’s nonlegendary, draw a card.
flavor: “Come into my shade.” — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

name: Nature’s Prophet
rules:
Vigilance, reach
Whenever you tap a land for mana, add an additional G.
Whenever Nature’s Prophet attacks, untap all lands you control.
flavor: “Ah, the sun in my leaves.”

name: Rotund'jere, Necrophos
rules:
Opponents can’t gain life.
Whenever another creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, put a -1/-1 counter on each creature you don’t control.
flavor: “You become feast for the flesh flies.”

name: Balanar, the Night Stalker
